doc: F3 — `AuditSealed K ↔ ∀ s a a', equalPriorBayesError (K (s, a)) (K (s, a')) = 1/2`.
pretty:
∀ {S : Type uS} {A : Type uA} {Y : Type uY} [inst : Fintype Y] (K : AuditCP.AuditChannel S A Y),
  AuditCP.AuditSealed K ↔ ∀ (s : S) (a a' : A), AuditCP.equalPriorBayesError (K (s, a)) (K (s, a')) = 1 / 2
